race.title: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com Mares Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: Preference is for REBEL REBA , who offered more at Galway last month and remains low mileage. Western Shores looks the obvious danger on form, whilst Gratitudeforgrace may also get in the money. REBEL REBA (IRE) WESTERN SHORES (IRE) GRATITUDEFORGRACE (FR)
